title: Copilot Studio: Dataverse agent users from Entra agent IDs GA
summary: Microsoft says the ability to create Dataverse agent users backed by a Microsoft Entra agent's user account reaches general availability on 8 December 2026 (MC1560996, read via a third-party mirror; the related roadmap item 576843 already shows the Dataverse side as launched). Agents built in Copilot Studio can then be provisioned as their own Dataverse users with dedicated, least-privilege security roles, and their actions are audited as the agent rather than as a shared service account or the calling user. It follows the Entra Agent ID governance announced at Ignite.
why: Agents that read and write business data under a maker's account or a shared app user are hard to scope and impossible to audit cleanly. A per-agent Entra identity with a dedicated Dataverse role gives you something you can review, restrict with Conditional Access for agents and switch off.
